The product likely is something like Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1C(C(=O)O)C(=O)O? Actually reaction is Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated acid. But here we have sulfonamide aromatic with aldehyde? The precursor includes C=O (aldehyde) on aromatic ring. So product would be unsaturated acid attached to aromatic sulfonamide. Hard.

Similarly step3 same precursors.
